setup.title: The Little Red Car
setup.style: Live-action macro photography of toys at toy scale, shallow depth of field, one sunny corner of a child's bedroom seen from the floor; the toys move on their own; one continuous shot per prompt.

cast.name: Pip
cast.description: Pip, a small plastic toy-brick minifigure with a round yellow head and a smiling printed face, a red cap, a blue torso and black legs.

extras.music: A bouncy marimba and whistling melody with light hand percussion.

shots.prompt: A low macro shot of a sunny corner of a child's bedroom, with light wooden floorboards, a low white bookshelf, a potted plant in a clay pot and a wicker toy basket, where Pip stands beside a small open cardboard box. Pip, the toy-brick minifigure with a round yellow head, a red cap, a blue torso and black legs, looks at a picture card leaning against the empty box. It shows the little red car, an open-top toy-brick car with one big red brick as its body on four black wheels, a single black seat, a clear windshield, a black steering wheel and a yellow headlight piece with two round lights on the front. He looks around the bedroom corner, nods and sets off to find the parts, one at a time. The camera sits at floor level with shallow depth of field, the bookshelf and the plant blurred behind. No people or human hands appear; the toys move on their own.
